description: Python source code implementing a Natural Language Inference (NLI) service using the DeBERTa model, including model loading, entailment checking, batch processing, and claim verification.

classes.name: NLIService
classes.description: A class providing methods for entailment checking, batch processing, and claim verification using a pretrained DeBERTa model.

methods.name: _get_model
methods.description: Lazy loads the NLI model and tokenizer from the transformers library.

methods.name: check_entailment
methods.description: Checks whether a hypothesis is entailed, contradicted, or neutral with respect to a premise.

methods.name: batch_check_entailment
methods.description: Performs entailment checks for multiple hypotheses against the same premise.

methods.name: verify_claim
methods.description: Verifies a claim against a context with configurable thresholds for entailment and contradiction.

methods.name: get_nli_service
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the NLIService instance.
